title: Quality control concerns and deduction points
summary: This topic centers on perceived quality-control issues, appearance flaws, and point deductions, with a few fragments that are too vague to classify clearly.

positive.summary: Positive feedback is limited to a brief mention of unspecified good points without concrete quality details.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe poor manufacturer quality control and a sense that customer concerns are not being addressed.

mixed.summary: Mixed feedback notes visible dull spots and missing quality control while stopping short of a wholly negative judgment.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention taking off points or suggesting safety improvements without enough context to infer clear sentiment about quality control.

limitations: The sample is very small, so examples are insufficient for broad conclusions about this topic.
Some fragments are vague and do not clearly state what issue led to point deductions or suggested improvements.
The topic includes loosely connected ideas such as quality control, scoring points, and safety suggestions, so coherence is limited.
